note: Demo-only research plan for scripts/tavily-research.ts. Public professional information only, nothing personal. Judge questions are expanded per judge from demo/judges.json. Placeholders: {name} {title} {company}; {who} = "full name" (OR "alias") + company + title, the full disambiguating context. fallbackQuery runs once only when no first-pass result mentions the name together with the company or a title keyword. profileSite: when the judge has a knownUrls entry on that site, the script extracts that exact URL instead of searching.

judgeQuestions.question: What is publicly known about {name}'s professional work as {title} at {company}?
What is {name}'s public GitHub profile and notable public repositories?
What recent public talks, podcasts, webinars or posts has {name} ({title}, {company}) given or published?
judgeQuestions.query: {who} talk OR podcast OR webinar OR keynote

judgeQuestions.question: What articles, blog posts or papers has {name} ({title}, {company}) published?
Which projects or products has {name} built or led as {title} at {company}?
judgeQuestions.query: {who} project OR launch OR built OR leads

judgeQuestions.question: What has {name} ({company}) said publicly about AI agents, agent memory, open models or inference?
judgeQuestions.query: {who} AI agents OR memory OR "open models" OR inference
